pyq_bad.why: wrong options: options belong to another question (national symbols)

patterns: APPSC tilt is national symbols with AP link: flag designer Pingali Venkayya, his 1906 Calcutta AICC inspiration.
Origin of the idea: M.N. Roy 1934 / INC demand 1935-36 / August Offer 1940 - years are the trap.
Quote-identification (Patel on separate electorates) and 'which party demanded dissolution' (Socialist Party) appear in recent state PSCs.
App covers composition numbers (211, 389, 299) and Andhra members well; PYQs rarely ask Objectives Resolution or committee chairs here.
